name: code-campus-microservices-root
description: Production-grade microservices orchestrator for Code Campus

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix user-service && npm install --prefix post-service && npm install --prefix exam-service && npm install --prefix course-service && npm install --prefix enrollment-service && npm install --prefix coding-service && npm install --prefix notification-service && npm install --prefix chat-service
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,USER,POST,EXAM,COURSE,ENROLL,CODE,NOTIF,CHAT" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,red,black,gray,white,yellowBright" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:post" "npm run dev:exam" "npm run dev:course" "npm run dev:enrollment" "npm run dev:coding" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:chat"
